api.rateLimited: Too many requests — please slow down

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.sessionChanged: Session changed — now signed in as {uid}.
auth.sessionEnded: Session ended — signed out in another tab.

blackboard.pullRequired: Go to the newest entry first, then try again.
blackboard.reorderVirtual: Can't reorder — the NEW page isn't a real entry yet.
blackboard.noData: Nothing to upload. Write something first.
blackboard.filesPartialFail: COMMIT: {count} file(s) couldn't upload — will retry on next sync.
blackboard.tagUpdateFailed: Synced to cloud, but local sync indicator is stale. Refresh to fix.
blackboard.autoSyncFailed: AUTO-SYNC: Could not reach server — will retry on next edit

walkieTypie.noLocalData: No messages yet. Start typing to create one.
walkieTypie.uploadFailed: {name} couldn't upload — will retry on next sync.
walkieTypie.commitFailed: Sync failed — your message may not reach your partner.
walkieTypie.realtimeUnavailable: Live typing is unavailable — messages still sync on save.

broadcast.notOwner: Only the owner can do this.
broadcast.realtimeUnavailable: Live updates unavailable — refresh to see new posts.
broadcast.uploadFailed: {name} couldn't upload — will retry on next cast.
broadcast.reorderVirtual: Can't reorder — the NEW page isn't a real entry yet.

files.renameDuplicate: This record already has a file with this name.
files.duplicateInRecord: This record already has this file.
files.openBlocked: Popup blocked — allow popups to open this local file.

system.loginRequired: Please log in for this action.
system.storageFull: Storage full. Changes may not be saved.

hints.push: Go forward to a newer entry. If you're already at the newest, a blank page appears — type anything and it becomes a new entry.
hints.pull: Go back to an older entry. If you typed something on a blank page, it's saved first.
hints.commit: Upload ALL entries from the selected topic to the cloud, replacing the entire cloud copy. If another device uploaded first, your version wins. File attachments included. If a file fails to upload, the text still goes through and the file retries on next sync.
hints.checkout: Download the selected topic from the cloud, replacing your local copy.
hints.switch: Jump to a different topic. If it only exists in the cloud, it's downloaded first.
hints.fork: Copy every entry from the selected topic into a new unnamed topic. The original and copy are fully separate — changes to one never affect the other.
hints.dropClean: Erase all entries in this topic. One blank placeholder stays behind so the topic itself survives.
hints.dropDrop: Remove the cloud copy of this topic. Your local entries stay untouched.
hints.dropDelete: Permanently delete this empty topic. Cannot be undone.
hints.themeToggle: Switch between dark and light theme. Requires the Light Theme extension.
hints.shelfHandle: Extension panel handle. Drag left to see more, right to see less. Double-click to close.
hints.wipeLocal: Clear 5 local data tables: Blackboard topics + records, Walkie-Typie pair-board records, Broadcast channel list + their records, and the cached file attachments. Does NOT touch your settings, language, login, or anything on the server. Page reloads after. Three-step confirmation.
hints.dropAllBranches: Delete every Blackboard topic you own from the server. Login required. Local data stays (use 'Wipe Local Data' to clear that too). Three-step confirmation.
hints.installApp: Install the app to your device for offline access and a native-window launch. On iOS, use Safari's Add to Home Screen.
hints.initializeWebsiteData: Clear every local cache (IndexedDB, Cache API, Service Worker, localStorage, sessionStorage) and reload. The device returns to a first-visit state. Your login survives — the login cookie is HttpOnly and this cannot touch it, so after reload you will be recognised again. You lose: settings, extensions, language choice, navi position, and any local-only drafts. Three-step confirmation.
hints.resetConfig: Reset the settings on this page (record limit, attachment limit, auto-clean, etc.) to their defaults. Three-step confirmation.
hints.clearToast: Dismiss all notifications currently on screen.
hints.unbindEmail: Disconnect your email from this account. You can register it again later via the email register flow.
hints.deleteAccount: Permanently delete this account and everything on the server. Can't be undone. You'll be signed out.
hints.chipStatus: File status: [Local] on this device only, [Synced] on both device and cloud, [Cloud] only on the server (click to download). Click the icon to preview.

wt.theyPush: View a newer entry on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.theyPull: View an older entry on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.wePush: Go forward to a newer entry on your board. Partner sees a live preview in about 20ms; the change is fully synced to the cloud 2s later. At the newest, a blank page opens for a new message.
wt.wePull: Go back to an older entry on your board. Your text is saved first. The partner sees you switch in real-time.
wt.add: Connect with someone by entering their username. You each get your own board — you write on yours, they write on theirs, and both sides are visible in real-time (~20ms).
wt.cut: Disconnect your selected partner and erase all message history for this pair on both sides.
wt.theyBoard: Your partner's side — read-only. Shows their typing in near real-time; fully synced on their commit.

bc.pin: Save this channel to your favourites. Pinned channels stay at the top of your list.
bc.cast: Upload ALL your local entries to this channel, replacing its entire cloud content. This uploads everything, not just what's on screen. If a file fails to upload, the text still goes through and the file retries on next publish.
bc.create: Start a new local channel. Write entries first, then use Publish to make them public.
bc.delete: Permanently delete this channel and all its entries (local and cloud). Only the creator can do this. Cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Re-check all extensions and update their availability.

config.maxSlot: Max entries per topic. Oldest removed automatically when full.
config.maxFiles: Maximum attachments per entry. Beyond this, new attachments are rejected.
config.showHints: Show tooltip hints on hover. Turn off once you're comfortable with the buttons.
config.autoCleanBlanks: Remove blank entries automatically when you navigate. Keeps things tidy.
config.updateTimestamp: Move an edited entry to the top (newest). OFF = it stays where it was.
config.autoSync: Auto-sync the current topic: uploads 2s after you stop typing; other devices see the change within 4s. Other topics sync when you switch to them. Requires login.
config.loopList: When you scroll past the last row of this page's list (for example, Blackboard's branch list), the cursor jumps to the first row — and vice versa when scrolling up past the first. OFF = the cursor stops at the top / bottom and won't advance. Turn ON for faster navigation through long lists.
config.boardSwap: Put your board on top, partner's below. Default: partner's messages are on top.
config.notifications: Desktop notifications when a message arrives and the tab is backgrounded. Requires browser permission.
config.screensaverTimeout: Seconds after you leave this tab before the screensaver appears. Set to max to disable.
config.crtBlendMode: Full CRT screen lines. OFF = lines blend with content and fade on text.

llm.button: Send your text to AI. The result appears in the panel below.
llm.provider: Where AI runs — in your browser (offline, private), on a local server, or in the cloud (needs internet + API key).
llm.clientModel: AI model that runs in your browser. Bigger = smarter, but needs more graphics memory.
llm.apiProvider: Which cloud AI service to use (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
llm.apiModel: The specific model from your cloud provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini).
llm.apiKey: Your secret API key. Stored on your device only — never sent to our server.
llm.temperature: How creative the AI is. Low = focused. High = varied. 0.3–0.7 is a good middle ground.

llmBb.button: Have AI analyze your entries (summarize, extract, transform).
llmBb.target: What to analyze: entries from the current topic, the topic list, or all topics combined.

llmBc.button: Have AI analyze the channel content.
llmBc.target: What to analyze: the current entry, or all entries in the channel.

translate.button: Translate your text to another language. Result appears in the panel below.

stt.button: Record from your microphone. Speech is converted to text and inserted into the editor.

markdownPreview.button: See your text as formatted Markdown in the panel below (headings, bold, lists, etc.).

aa.matrixRain: Falling green characters on the idle screen, Matrix-style. Pure decoration.
aa.perlinBg: A gentle flowing texture behind your content. Subtle atmosphere.
aa.mouseLight: A soft glow that follows your cursor, like a flashlight on screen.
aa.toastAnim: A spinning animation on notifications and text panels. Shows that something is processing.

misc.installUnavailable: Install not available — needs a Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera); Firefox desktop doesn't support this. On Chromium, the browser only offers install after you've used the app a bit.
misc.installIosHint: On iOS: tap Share → Add to Home Screen to install.

mods.configDefault: Select an extension from the list.
mods.catalogPreview: Add this extension to start configuring.
mods.validationFailed: Extension '{id}' failed to load — check console
